summary: This is a shell script that tests a typo-reporting API endpoint. It fetches a security nonce token, submits a test report, verifies the admin dashboard works, confirms file protection is in place, and validates that the API correctly rejects requests missing a nonce or containing invalid data.

explanations.2: curl fetches data from the URL, -s silences progress output, and jq -r .nonce extracts just the nonce value as plain text (not JSON-formatted).
explanations.5: -X POST tells curl to send a POST request instead of the default GET.
explanations.7: The -d flag sends the JSON payload as the request body; $NONCE is replaced with the value we stored earlier.
explanations.11: The ?admin=YOUR_TOKEN query parameter requests the admin view, which shows all collected reports organized by slug.
explanations.15: -I tells curl to fetch only the HTTP headers, not the full response body, which is faster when you just want to check the status code.
explanations.19: This test intentionally omits the nonce field to verify the API rejects unauthenticated requests.
explanations.27: This test uses an invalid type value ("question" instead of an allowed type like "typo") to verify the API validates input correctly.
